name: tora_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a big muscular paint monster shaped like a tiger man, exactly the character in the front and side view references. His whole body, face included, is made of glossy brown paint; the cream color lies in random, messy splotches and smears with ragged edges, wherever the paint happened to fall, as in the references. A few thin golden streaks, paint dripping from the chin, jaw, arms, thighs and tail, pointed ears, short spiky brown hair, fluffy cheek fur made of the same brown paint, very thick dark eyebrows, brown eyes, a wide, flat dark brown nose that is much wider than it is tall, with an almost straight top edge, the underside curving in from both sides to a short soft point, and two small nostrils at its lower corners, the space between the nose and the mouth plain smooth brown, calm closed-mouth smile, a long thick tail, straight human-shaped legs with bare human feet, arms hanging relaxed at his sides. Three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose. Same pixel art style and size as the reference crocodile sprite: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips.
